# SmartHomeDeviceCard

**Class:** `SmartHomeDeviceCard` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomePanel.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomePanel.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomePanel.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

One device or scene as a press target

## Overview

@brief Device card widget Individual card representing a smart home device. Shows device icon, name, status, and provides quick actions.

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
SmartHomeDeviceCard(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
SmartHomeDeviceCard(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeDeviceCard(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).
